heading.title: Central and State Advisory Boards on Disability and District Level Committee

article.title: Meetings of State Advisory Board on disability.
article.content: The State Advisory Board shall meet at least once in every six months and shall observe such rules or procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be prescribed by the State Government.
article.html:
70Meetings of State Advisory Board on disability.

Section 70 · Chapter XI · page 25 of the Act

The State Advisory Board shall meet at least once in every six months and shall observe such rules or procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be prescribed by the State Government.
